name: Question 8
problem: A particle moves along a straight line relative to a fixed origin $O$ with acceleration, measured in $\text{m}/{\text{s}}^{2},$ given by the function $a(t)=3\operatorname{cos}⁡(4t)$, where $t$ is the time in seconds. If the particle has velocity $v=0\,\text{m}/\text{s}$ when $t=\frac{\pi }{2}\,\text{s}$, find the velocity of the particle at time $t=\frac{\pi }{8}\,\text{s}.$
worked_solution:
First, we find $v(t)$ by integrating the acceleration with respect to time:

$$
\begin{aligned}v(t) & =\int a(t)\,\text{d}t \\  & =\int (3\operatorname{cos}⁡(4t))\,\text{d}t \\  & =3(\frac{1}{4}\operatorname{sin}⁡(4t))+C \\  & =\frac{3}{4}\operatorname{sin}⁡(4t)+C.\end{aligned}
$$

To determine $C$, we use the fact that $v(\frac{\pi }{2})=0.$ Substituting this into the above gives

$$
\begin{aligned}0 & =\frac{3}{4}\operatorname{sin}⁡(4\cdot \frac{\pi }{2})+C \\ 0 & =\frac{3}{4}\operatorname{sin}⁡(2\pi )+C \\ C & =0.\end{aligned}
$$

Therefore, the velocity $v$ of the particle at time $t$ is $v(t)=\frac{3}{4}\operatorname{sin}⁡(4t).$

Finally, we evaluate the velocity at time $t=\frac{\pi }{8}\,\text{s}$:

$$
\begin{aligned}v(\frac{\pi }{8}) & =\frac{3}{4}\operatorname{sin}⁡(4\cdot \frac{\pi }{8}) \\  & =\frac{3}{4}\operatorname{sin}⁡(\frac{\pi }{2}) \\  & =\frac{3}{4}\cdot 1 \\  & =\frac{3}{4} \\  & =0.75\,\text{m}/\text{s}\,.\end{aligned}
$$

Question 8
?

A particle moves along a straight line relative to a fixed origin O with acceleration, measured in m/s2, given by the function a(t)=3cos⁡(4t), where t is the time in seconds. If the particle has velocity v=0m/s when t=π2s, find the velocity of the particle at time t=π8s.

a
1.33m/s
b
0.75m/s2
c
1.25m/s
d
0.75m/s
e
0m/s
Submit
Correct
EXPLANATION

First, we find v(t) by integrating the acceleration with respect to time: v(t)=∫a(t)dt=∫(3cos⁡(4t))dt=3(14sin⁡(4t))+C=34sin⁡(4t)+C. To determine C, we use the fact that v(π2)=0. Substituting this into the above gives 0=34sin⁡(4⋅π2)+C0=34sin⁡(2π)+CC=0. Therefore, the velocity v of the particle at time t is v(t)=34sin⁡(4t).

Finally, we evaluate the velocity at time t=π8s: v(π8)=34sin⁡(4⋅π8)=34sin⁡(π2)=34⋅1=34=0.75m/s.
